item.text:
Implemented `matchRoute(pattern, pathname)` in [src/route.ts](C:\Users\bash\AppData\Local\Temp\offcut-bench-work-BsVIaZ\repo\src\route.ts).

It now:

- Matches complete slash-separated paths.
- Requires literal segments to match exactly.
- Captures and decodes `:parameter` segments.
- Returns `null` for mismatches or malformed URI encoding.
- Safely handles parameter names such as `__proto__`.

Verified with Node assertions and `git diff --check`.
